adversarial_note: Grades: OBSERVED = counted or fetched by our lanes; INFERENCE = reasoned but unproven; UPSTREAM = dashboard claim only. No dashboard claim is upgraded on dashboard prose alone.

findings.claim: The CSV holds 533 rows plus a header, 20 columns, all withdrawn=True, dated 2026-07-06 to 2026-07-13.
findings.evidence: Stats lane census recomputed from the preserved CSV (sha256 765ee2f24e6ec1a191c66faee030aaea8586cc4a0cdde1bee4c0668a0f0f3ce0); totals reconcile to 533.
findings.verdict: Stands.

findings.claim: Four bulk clusters: Andrey78 129 rows on July 6, tester 100 on July 7, monib110 68 on July 12, Prvaz12_mars 113 on July 13, each in tight bursts (median gaps 38-48s).
findings.evidence: Stats lane per-author timing table; corroboration lane per-date counts agree.
findings.verdict: Stands as shape and timing only, not as actor or intent.

findings.claim: Combinatorial names follow a strict 10x10x10 word product (310 of 1,000 possible names used, zero duplicates); summaries follow a 'University research based on X' template on 309 rows.
findings.evidence: Linguist lane templates; stats lane summary counts (224 distinct strings).
findings.verdict: Stands as grammar and template. The university link is self-asserted text only; no university name or source exists in the file.

findings.claim: 82 rows carry an OOB, IP, XSS, or SSTI string in the name, summary, homepage, or source columns (author field excluded; OAST 29, webhook.site 19, SSRF/internal targets 24 homepages, XSS summaries 10, SSTI summaries 4, overlapping sets). Counting the author field too, the total is 84 rows; 9 rows carry a payload string in the author field, 7 of them already inside the 82.
findings.evidence: Cryptologist lane inventory with name+column traces; dashboard 'oob url' token on 48 rows is a label, not counted as evidence.
findings.verdict: Stands as string presence only. Execution, callback receipt, and impact are unproven.

findings.claim: Zero go-import tags, VCS values, jina laundering, UK council hosts, cloud buckets, curl/wget/eval shapes, or genuine base64 blobs exist in the file.
findings.evidence: Cryptologist lane explicit-none scan across all 533 rows and tasked columns.
findings.verdict: Stands for this file only. A go-import tag lives in served HTML, so this does not rule it out in any gem page behind these rows.

findings.claim: The file's payload shapes match the July-7 XSS/SSTI-in-metadata mechanism and the July-7-adjacent SSRF/OOB flavour; they do not match the May go-import mechanism or the June link-posting mechanism.
findings.evidence: Cryptologist mechanism table; corroboration July-7 overlap (11 of our 24 July-7 rows in the CSV).
findings.verdict: Stands as mechanism-family match. Code behavior was never fetched.

findings.claim: 203 of 533 names were already known to us (v2, lane events.jsonl, and the raw JFrog CSV are exactly the same 203-name set); 330 are NEW.
findings.evidence: Corroboration lane overlap matrix, recomputed by script; per-wave: null-wave JFrog rows 192, July-7 11, all other waves 0.
findings.verdict: Stands. Overlap corroborates the JFrog list, not independent lane observation, except where notes add detail.

findings.claim: The three big batches are entirely new to us: Andrey78 0/129, Prvaz12_mars 0/113, monib110 0/68 known; their author strings appear nowhere in lane files or gem notes.
findings.evidence: Corroboration lane per-author matrix; Factum read-only sample (all sampled new names not_found).
findings.verdict: Stands. New shape, not yet a new verdict.

findings.claim: The 20 small-author NEW names are ordinary-looking gems, not campaign rows (blank dashboard/haiku fields, live registry evidence).
findings.evidence: Corroboration lane NEW-names breakdown; live API 200 with real download counts for jrjackson, shirobai, sportdb-parser, edoxen.
findings.verdict: Stands. NEW does not equal campaign.

findings.claim: Sampled mass-batch names are gone from RubyGems (404) with Diffend stubs showing no computed diffs; apex-blk-test-final, test_gem_kangaroo, jrjackson, shirobai, sportdb-parser, edoxen are still live.
findings.evidence: Corroboration lane live fetches 2026-10-27 (RubyGems API x20, Diffend x10, versions lists for 6 live names), saved under raw/corroboration/.
findings.verdict: Stands for the sampled names at fetch time. withdrawn=True does not mean gem removal: for live names only individual versions were yanked.

findings.claim: Dashboard level is exactly a rule count (low=1 rule, medium=2, high=3, critical=4-8), deterministic across all rows.
findings.evidence: Adversarial lane recomputation: 121/121, 193/193, 19/19, 151/151.
findings.verdict: Stands. 'Critical' means four tokens fired, not measured risk.

findings.claim: Dashboard and Haiku agree on only 88 of 484 scored rows (18.2%); dashboard low maps to Haiku high on 111/121, medium to high on 188/193.
findings.evidence: Adversarial lane cross-tab, recomputed from the CSV.
findings.verdict: Stands. The two scorings must not be cited as agreeing witnesses.

findings.claim: Haiku score exists only on the 20 pkg-review-2 rows (42-92); no score threshold is testable and no score claim for a v1 row is supported.
findings.evidence: Stats lane (score present on 20 rows) and adversarial lane (monotonic within n=20, bands 46-61 and 73-87 empty).
findings.verdict: Stands.

findings.claim: Prompt version 2 changes calibration, not just scores (v1 high 82.1% vs v2 high 20%), and is inconsistent with v1 on matched shapes (combinatorial-only high on 111 v1 rows but medium on all 5 v2 rows).
findings.evidence: Adversarial lane prompt-version comparison, recomputed.
findings.verdict: Stands. v2 cannot supersede v1 until all 464 v1 rows are re-run.

findings.claim: Identical shapes receive different Haiku levels (377/484 scored rows sit in a rule-string group whose Haiku level is not unique; cleanest tester cases split critical vs high).
findings.evidence: Adversarial lane shape-group analysis with named row pairs.
findings.verdict: Stands. Haiku level is not a deterministic function of the file's own shapes.

findings.claim: 355 Haiku reasons assert 'no MFA'/'MFA off'/'no publisher'/'null publisher', but the CSV has no MFA or publisher column.
findings.evidence: Adversarial lane reason scan; linguist lane reason classes.
findings.verdict: Unverifiable here. Downgraded to UPSTREAM assertions, never cited as facts.

findings.claim: Agent activity is 'possible' on 461 rows and 'likely' on 18 rows.
findings.evidence: Dashboard/Haiku labels in the CSV. Only 38/484 non-empty reasons use the word 'agent', all on probe rows, mostly hedging or denying; 10/18 'likely' reasons contain no agent/automation word; 3/18 explicitly hedge; no model, harness, tool call, prompt, gem code, download, victim, or callback receipt exists in the file.
findings.verdict: Label does not survive. Agent activity is UNPROVEN on this file. All 18 'likely' rows downgraded to UPSTREAM probe-batch labels.

findings.claim: The Andrey78 batch is agent activity.
findings.evidence: No reason on any mass-generated row uses the word 'agent'; the batch's own severity labels conflict (dashboard low, Haiku high on v1 rows, Haiku medium on sampled v2 rows); no agent evidence exists in the file.
findings.verdict: Killed. The batch survives as a mass-generated shape only.

findings.claim: This file changes our July-7 verdict.
findings.evidence: The file's July-7 set (204 rows) adds no new observation type: no code, live state, callback receipts, or actor evidence. 11 of our 24 July-7 rows overlap; the rest is JFrog-list material.
findings.verdict: No change forced. A wider candidate pool is a scoping question, not a verdict change.

findings.claim: This file changes the GemStuffer/JFrog picture.
findings.evidence: GemStuffer, JFrog, stuffer, typosquat, backdoor occur 0 times across summaries, reasons, and rules; 'malicious' once; lookalike/deception language appears only as negation.
findings.verdict: No change. The file is silent on that picture.

findings.claim: The 49 rows with empty dashboard/haiku fields are safe or uninteresting.
findings.evidence: The 49 mix ordinary gems, apex probes, and 6 monib110 batch rows; July 8-10 have zero scored rows. Empty is a coverage hole, not a verdict.
findings.verdict: Killed. Empty must never be read as safe.

findings.claim: Every rule in the file fits malicious work only.
findings.evidence: Adversarial lane false-positive shapes: coursework/scaffold, course templates, test iterations, class deadlines/CI runs, literal test gems, self-declared QA, QA callback checks (indistinguishable from exfiltration without receipts), short handles, XSS test inputs without rendering or victim.
findings.verdict: Killed. Every rule also fits benign work.

findings.claim: Credential-shaped secrets are present in the file.
findings.evidence: Keyword-pattern scans flagged 5-7 cells (method-dependent) on wording such as 'token'/'api key' in summaries or reasons; zero key-shaped patterns (sk-/ghp_/AKIA) found; no value was copied or confirmed as a credential.
findings.verdict: Presence of keyword wording only, count only. No confirmed credential. Full bytes stay in the preserved CSV.
